steps.content:
1:21 a.m., March 20, N.F. 113
Inner Bay Shelter lounge
You've returned to the shelter. The atmosphere here is now completely different from when you left.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: What an unexpected success this mission was! We reached the lower depths of the mine, surveyed the terrain, and cleared many obstacles.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: If I didn't have to use up all my beautiful writing for the last battle, there'd be a lot of notes in this notebook! But it doesn't matter. I've retained everything in my mind. The next try will be a swift victory!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, I'm taking your girls to get some rest. You should take a nap and then come find me. We still have a lot of things to discuss.

<size=30>She winks at you and takes the Sinners away. Some of the combatants have been affected by Mania, but luckily, you can control it with your shackles. You'd never forgive yourself if these people who put their lives on the line for you turned into Corruptors.</size>
Everyone thanks you for your shackles, but there's no joy in their voices, only fatigue and despair. The eyes that had all been focused on you are now scattered, full of doubt and anxiety.

You're not surprised. After all, the mission failed. You were unable to reach the bottom of BR-002, and failed to destroy the dead half of the Corpus. The entire shelter is enveloped by worry and despair.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hecate, it's time to sleep.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This bed can fit us both. They made it nice and clean and comfy for us. Just relax now. Others are keeping guard. Come?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm not sleeping.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But you look like you're about to black out? Your body needs to rest.
It's rare for Hella to be so polite, but she gets no response. Hecate sits with her back to the door, facing Hella but not looking at her at all.
The Syndicate girl can't hold back her temper any longer.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What the heck has gotten into you lately? You're mopey in everything you do, and you put on a grumpy face even with ${PlayerName}! Plus, you keep picking fights on your own!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What did we do piss you off so much?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No. I'm not angry. It's pointless to talk about this.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's not pointless! You're making me angry! I have no idea what's going on, and I don't like that!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We still have to be around each other for another few days! Tell me what's wrong now, or else I'll call ${PlayerName} over, too!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Don't disturb Chief's rest.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: My behavior has nothing to do with you, Hella. Our mission is to protect Chief. That's the only thing you should think about.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?? You didn't listen to what I said at all! What I'm concerned about is...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your concerns are meaningless to the mission.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Go to sleep now.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw... Three armored units have been defeated, but the west side of the Drifter Camp has fallen. Taran is trying his best to defend the main gate...

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Julien is still alive, but badly injured. He's under a lot of pressure and hasn't completely healed after the surgery... Caw...

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Need more companions... Need more companions...
Raven paces about and mumbles to herself as she changes out of the contamination-stained Executive Officer uniform.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Hmm... what should I put in the next mobilization letter...
A black shadow zips across the ground, then suddenly flies up, striking the ceiling light. The room is instantly plunged into darkness.
Before Raven has a chance to move, several streaks of black fluid wrap around her limbs, torso and neck.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: So you're the one Ica called help from... I figured.
As soon as Raven finishes speaking, a sharp metal object presses against her neck—somehow, her quill pen had silently fallen into the intruder's hands.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Well, if it isn't the little punk who skipped class and dropped out of school... You remembered to come back to see your teacher?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You've been on vacation for quite a while. Did you finish all your holiday homework?

steps.speaker: Shadow Assassin
steps.content: Shut up, dumb bird. I'll pull your tongue out.
